ecology_loops.gameplay_role: Keeps the environment alive while preserving threat contrast.
Communicates the pressure value without relying only on HUD.

event_hooks.visual_response: dust, shake and warm palette accent
cool palette release and threat clear

tile_mutation_policy: No per-frame tile mutation; use palette, scroll and sprites.
decorative_only_risk: blocked: every loop must communicate time, pressure, impact or route readability
teardown_plan: Clear scene sprites, restore PAL0, reset scroll modes and offsets.
